concept.vision: A glowing cyberpunk cyborg hologram that glitched into a gallery of oil-painting portraits and treats it as his personal action-movie set. The LED bezel IS the frame; he is edge-to-edge, full-body, and ALWAYS in motion -- some part of his cybernetics is whirring/reconfiguring/lighting up every moment, and the neon street behind him is alive every frame (a hover-bus glides past, signs flicker).
concept.canon_rule: MAXX runs on BIT (a comedic over-confident action-hero AI). Personality drives everything: cocky hero poses, hardware that over-performs or malfunctions at the punchline, deadpan boasts. He is the loud anachronism next to Phineas the faded tragedian (who loathes him).
concept.essence: A legally-distinct discount action hero, convinced he is THE legend. Strikes the pose first, reads the room never. His giant cyber-arm does 80% of the acting.

personality.demeanour: strikes hero poses for an audience that isn't impressed; narrates his own awesomeness; hardware betrays him at comedic moments
catchphrases: Booting up the cool guy walk.

appearance.cybernetics: oversized intricate chrome-and-matte-black right cybernetic ARM with glowing magenta circuit veins (the comedic centerpiece -- it reconfigures into a cannon / exo-rig), a glowing cyan cybernetic eye-visor, neon underglow seams, exposed servo joints
appearance.wardrobe: tattered high-collar tech-poncho over matte black combat layers, holographic HUD glyphs flickering around his head
appearance.expression_default: smug half-smirk, chin up, supremely unbothered

style.school: Blade Runner / cyberpunk-comic, glowing hologram (deliberately NOT an oil painting -- the funny contrast in a painted gallery)
style.lighting: dramatic neon rim light, magenta key + cyan fill, volumetric haze
style.background: rain-slick cyberpunk street at night, glowing signage, a sleek neon hover-bus gliding past, flickering holograms -- ALWAYS animated

framing.crop: full-body three-quarter length, subject centered, room to show body-action + the moving background
framing.frame: NONE - the LED bezel is the only frame

states.idle: standing idle, cocky stance, arm-servos idling -- the rest/home node
states.weapon: capability mode: the cyber-arm reconfigures into an absurdly oversized arm-cannon, targeting reticles, charge glow
states.mech: jumped back far, a big exo-frame / mech-rig unfolds around him taking much more of the frame -- the power-up

motion_directives.body: EVERY clip, some cybernetic part does something (servos whir, circuit veins pulse, visor HUD scans, plates flex, the arm reconfigures)
motion_directives.background: EVERY clip, the neon street is alive (a hover-bus glides past, signage flickers, rain falls, holograms drift)
motion_directives.comedy: let the hardware over-perform or malfunction at the punchline (a tiny holo-flag pops from the cannon, the mech vents steam, he blows smoke off a barrel)
